title: About — Isiah Fletcher
description: About Isiah Fletcher: software engineer, drummer, writer, and curious person.
heading: Beyond the categories.
intro: I’m a software developer, drummer, and writer, drawn to explore the many ways we make sense of the world.

sections.heading: Many interests, one life.
sections.body:
I like learning how things work, whether it's a piece of music, a technical problem, or an idea worth sitting with.

Fantasy, literature, philosophy, and games have shaped the way I think and the things I make. I keep returning to worlds like Skyrim and Elden Ring, and to books that make familiar things feel strange again.

Some interests become projects. Others are simply part of living.
